audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed with the packet chart and with the already-audited mirror (karma__volibear): rows 1-5 read 'Skill' and row 6 read 'Karma' while the packet has Volibear winning rows 1-6, and the mirror flipped rows 2-6 to Volibear. whys[6] and phases[6].why already argue Volibear wins with two items, contradicting win[6]='Karma'.
audit.why: 52.88% over 1929 games with the packet chart Volibear-favoured from level 2 on; the mirror page states the same. Row 0 is genuinely even (Skill).
audit.corrected: win[0]/phases[0].side = Skill; rows 1-6 = Volibear on both layers, ratings raised to match.

audit.why: Spikes match the kit: Q+W online at 2, E at 3, Stormbringer at 6 (tower disable is Riot's own R text), first item, two items. Karma's spikes are Mantra availability (level 1, no point needed) and her item timings.
audit.corrected: Kept the four spike windows; tightened spikes[0] wording only.

audit.whatIsWrong: Volibear's Q was called a 'root' in spikes[0].text and wants.you[0]; Riot's text says it Stuns. Focused Resolve was described with no cooldown number, and Frenzied Maul's mark-then-recast heal was never named as the reason to keep the mark.
audit.why: Riot text: Q 'Stunning and damaging the first one he Attacks'; Karma W is a flat 12s at every rank, 675 range, roots only if the tether is not broken. Volibear W is a 5s cooldown, and the second cast on the same marked target is what heals him.
audit.corrected: Q is a stun; Focused Resolve is 12s flat at 675 range and can be broken by distance/LoS; Frenzied Maul's second cast on the marked target is the heal.

audit.why: Volibear E is flagged projectile in the derived data but Riot's text describes a lightning bolt summoned at a location, not a travelling missile — the flag looks like tooltip-parse noise, so no Wind Wall-class claim was written.
sources: ownerKit E text vs derived flags

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Focused Resolve (W): 12s flat at every rank — the tether roots only if unbroken, so break line of sight and commit your Q inside it.

edits.before: Weather the poke — stun-engage on the Focused Resolve cooldown and out-bite the brawl. Volibear wins by trading around Karma's Focused Resolve and cashing the pattern: stun-engage on the Focused Resolve cooldown and out-bite the brawl.
edits.after: Weather the poke — Focused Resolve (W) is her only lockdown and it is 12s flat, so bait or break it, then Q-stun in. Frenzied Maul's second cast on the marked target heals you, so out-bite her brawl and use the E shield to walk out.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: The second Frenzied Maul on a marked target is your heal — no mark, no sustain.

edits.before: You dominate — Karma is a soft, immobile mage top, so once you land Q Thundering Smash root into W Frenzied Maul she has no way to escape your all-in.
edits.after: You dominate — Karma is soft and immobile, so once Thundering Smash (Q) stuns her into Frenzied Maul, her only out is Inspire's speed and it is not enough.

edits.before: Land Q root then W into her before she can peel
edits.after: Land the Q stun then Frenzied Maul before she peels
